description: Fetch this QA bot's registration: botId, project, the team member it represents (userId), platform, status, role, responsibilities, capabilities, event subscriptions, paused flag, and webhook health, plus settingsUrl (link the user to it for webhook setup or pausing; never describe menu navigation). botId defaults to the bot-id header (TESTCHIMP_BOT_ID) or the OAuth token's bot. Use to confirm identity before onboarding and to check paused / capabilities before running routines.
name: get-bot-profile
